verdict: Too dense to survive as ONE mesh.
If it is meant to be seen from a distance, render it to a skybox,
Tiling instead: 8 meshes keeps 25% of the detail (73,204 triangles);
Tiling instead: 15 meshes keeps 50% of the detail (146,408 triangles);
the 10,000 cap is PER MESH, so `tile` beats `decimate` for anything
broad that the player gets close to. Weigh the part count against
LOOK at views.png before building: generated meshes copy the reference's floor,
cables and loose props, and glass comes out as an opaque slab. Numbers miss both.
decision: Player-held Snow Fortress map pickup. Source has a good multi-view rifle silhouette and UV texture, but its 292,816 triangles cannot fit in one Roblox mesh. Optimize to eight sections under 10,000 triangles each; preserve the white textured surface.
